sources.title: NUIST September 18 notice: Changwang Building data-centre hosting and unused-equipment review
sources.publisher: 南京信息工程大学信息化建设与数据管理中心 (NUIST Information Technology and Data Management Centre)
sources.source_family: 南京信息工程大学信息化建设与数据管理中心 (NUIST Information Technology and Data Management Centre)
sources.attribution: 南京信息工程大学信息化建设与数据管理中心 (NUIST Information Technology and Data Management Centre)
sources.summary: NUIST identifies a data-centre room on the first floor of Changwang Building. Its September 18 notice calls for review of unused, powered-off and overdue hosted equipment to reclaim space and power capacity. Campus units seeking continued hosting must confirm their needs and obtain renewed approval; equipment no longer required is to be collected by September 24.
sources.original_title: 关于中心机房闲置、超期等托管设备集中清理工作的通知
sources.date_semantics: Visible publication and signed notice both September 18, 2026. The notice describes an existing hosting room and ongoing hosting management on that date. September 24 is a future collection deadline, not a verified clearance completion or a facility closure date.
sources.status_inference: Operational is inferred from the operator managing existing hosted equipment and explicitly permitting continued hosting. Idle, powered-off and overdue describe the subset under review, not the whole room. No individual server uptime or post-deadline outcome is asserted.
sources.room_number_limit: S103 is the contact office, not an identified data-centre room number.

sources.title: NUIST server-hosting service eligibility
sources.publisher: 南京信息工程大学信息化服务网 (NUIST Information Services)
sources.source_family: 南京信息工程大学信息化服务网 (NUIST Information Services)
sources.attribution: 南京信息工程大学信息化服务网 (NUIST Information Services)
sources.summary: The university network centre limits server-hosting applications to systems providing common services for university units, citing finite room space and electrical capacity. Applications are reviewed before hosting is approved. This is the centre’s undated service policy; it does not quantify the Changwang room’s power capacity or server count.
sources.date_semantics: Undated service page captured October 15. Context only; it does not refresh the September 18 operational observation.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap changeset 156755171: NUIST central campus building edit
sources.summary: The September 2024 contributor describes NUIST central-campus improvements, records survey and local knowledge, and lists Bing aerial imagery. These are contributor-provided provenance tags, not an Atlas survey or independent imagery validation.

sources.title: Shaanxi Xueqian Normal University: September 9 inspection of completed data-centre room renovation
sources.publisher: 陕西学前师范学院 (Shaanxi Xueqian Normal University)
sources.source_family: 陕西学前师范学院 (Shaanxi Xueqian Normal University)
sources.attribution: 陕西学前师范学院 (Shaanxi Xueqian Normal University)
sources.summary: A September 9 visit by the university vice-president confirmed that its data-centre room and power-room renovation had been completed over the summer. He inspected the refurbished rooms, discussed cabinet layout, power reliability and equipment operation, and reviewed the university’s monitoring and hyperconverged systems. The report confirms completed renovation, without specifying the day on which the works finished.
sources.original_title: 副校长李明军到网络与信息化管理处进行调研座谈
sources.date_semantics: Published September 11; the article explicitly dates the physical inspection to September 9 afternoon. September 9 is a confirmation date for already completed summer work, not an invented handover or original opening date.
sources.scope_limit: AI computing planned by the separate Information Engineering College is mentioned as future coordination; its capacity or status is not assigned to this room.

sources.title: Jixue Building A102 data-centre renovation: original procurement specifications
sources.publisher: 陕西学前师范学院 / 陕西省政府采购网 (university procurement document, Shaanxi Government Procurement)
sources.source_family: 陕西学前师范学院 / 陕西省政府采购网 (university procurement document, Shaanxi Government Procurement)
sources.attribution: 陕西学前师范学院 / 陕西省政府采购网 (university procurement document, Shaanxi Government Procurement)
sources.summary: The May 21 procurement document identifies the existing data-centre room as Jixue Building A102 and describes modifications to 16 existing IT cabinets. The package covers cooling, cold-aisle containment, power distribution, fire protection and room finishes, including associated power-room works. These are procurement requirements; the September inspection confirms general renovation completion but does not verify every specified item or a final cabinet inventory.
sources.original_title: 陕西学前师范学院数字校园达标建设项目-数据中心机房标准化改造项目(二次)
sources.date_semantics: The original DOCX cover is dated May 21, 2026, and its tender-availability period starts that day; the invitation signature retains April 24, 2026. The document was obtained from the visible attachment on the June 12 award. May 21 is used for the revised document’s cover date. Historical design/identity context only.
sources.extraction: Text extracted from original DOCX word/document.xml without changing raw bytes.
sources.scope_limit: At least 40 kW cooling is an air-conditioning specification, not IT load. Floor and ceiling treatment areas are work quantities, not verified room or facility GFA. Procurement grade requirements do not establish certification.

sources.title: Data-centre room standardisation renovation: June 12 procurement award
sources.publisher: 中国政府采购网 (China Government Procurement)
sources.source_family: 中国政府采购网 (China Government Procurement)
sources.attribution: 中国政府采购网 (China Government Procurement)
sources.summary: The university awarded the data-centre room standardisation renovation package to Shaanxi Hanfugong Construction Engineering for CNY 353,976. The award links the full procurement document naming Jixue Building A102. The amount is for this renovation contract, rather than the cost of the whole data centre; the award itself does not establish physical work or completion.
sources.original_title: 陕西学前师范学院数字校园达标建设项目-数据中心机房标准化改造项目(二次)中标（成交）结果公告
